claim: Lipid 14's linker arm: 3-(dimethylamino)propanoic acid (C3) vs 4-(dimethylamino)butyric acid (C4)
locus_a: SI p.17 Supp Fig 15 row 1 col 1, read at 600 dpi: the drawn reagent is Me2N-CH2CH2CH2-COOH and the drawn product has three CH2 between the ester carbonyl and the dimethylamino N
locus_b: OUR OWN FIRST READING of the same panel via pdfplumber's flattened text ('N COOH'), which has no geometry and which we wrongly completed as the C3 homologue of lipid 37's reagent
why: RETRACTED SUSPICION, kept with the measurement that retired it. The corpus itself settled it: ZT_2026's 'Lipid 14-CB1/2/3' rows in data/data_vivo.csv are cholesterol conjugates of this same lipid from a DIFFERENT paper, and their IL_SMILES carry ...CCOC(=O)CCC[N+](C)(C)... -- three CH2, the C4 acid. Two independent sources, one of them outside this paper.

claim: Linker assignment sentence names lipid 34 twice
locus_a: Results, 'Ionizable Lipid Design': 'for lipid 14 and lipid 34, an ester linker was used'
locus_b: same paragraph: 'an amide linker was used for lipid 34 and lipid 40'; and 'LNPs formulated with ester, reverse-ester, and carbonate linker-containing lipids (lipid 14, lipid 32, lipid 33, and lipid 37-39) had a negative zeta'
what_we_emitted: ester = lipids 14 and 37; amide = lipids 34 and 40
why: The first clause is a typo for lipid 37. The zeta sentence, the head-group sentence (lipids 37-42 are the N-methylpiperazine series) and SI p.31's own name for lipid 37 (a propanoyl-oxy ester) all place 37 in the ester pair. Lipid 34's SI name is a butanamido AMIDE.

locus_a: Methods, 'LNP In Vitro Testing': 'treated with LNPs at an mLuc mRNA concentration of 0.5 ug/mL, 0.25 ug/mL, and 0.125 ug/mL'
locus_b: Figure 2A/B/C x-axis labels, repeated under all 36 triplets: '0.25 ug/ml', '0.15 ul/ml', '0.025 ug/ml'
what_we_emitted: the FIGURE labels, 0.25 / 0.15 / 0.025 ug/mL, carried on every row with the unit string flagged
why: Unresolvable from the paper. Only '0.25' is common to both, and Figure 2's caption anchors its statistics to 'the 0.25 ug/mL treatment with lipid 14', which is the leftmost (highest) bar -- so the caption agrees with the figure and not with the Methods. The middle label also carries a unit typo ('ul/ml'). See DECISIONS D-1.

locus_a: Methods: 'Every treatment was performed in quadruplicate.'
locus_b: Figure 2 caption: 'Every measurement was performed in triplicate (n = 3 for every group)'
what_we_emitted: n recorded as the contradiction itself, not resolved
why: Does not change any value we emit; recorded because it changes the weight a reader would give the error bars.

locus_a: Results, 'In Vivo Screening': lungs PCC = 0.6345 p = 0.0267; liver PCC = -0.5815 p = 0.0474; kidneys PCC = -0.7378 p = 0.0062
locus_b: Supplementary Figure 5B's own table: lungs 0.7984 p = 0.0019; liver -0.8193 p = 0.0011; kidneys -0.7676 p = 0.0036
what_we_emitted: nothing -- we do not emit zeta
why: All three pairs disagree, in the same panel, between the text and the table the text cites. The other two panels the text quotes (5A size-vs-liver -0.6741 p 0.0162; 5C pKa-vs-lungs 0.8417 p 0.0006 and kidneys -0.6978 p 0.0116) match their tables exactly, so this is specific to panel B.

claim: Number of Monte Carlo formulations simulated in the DoE
locus_a: Results, 'LNP Preparation': 'simulated 10,000 theoretical formulations using a Monte Carlo simulation'
locus_b: Supplementary Figure 1 caption: 'we performed Monte Carlo Simulation of 100,000 hypothetical formulations'

why: One order of magnitude apart. Does not touch a value.

claim: Supplementary Figure 5D/E panel titles vs their plotted x ranges
locus_a: Supp Fig 5D is titled RAW264.7 with x from 5 to 9; Supp Fig 5E is titled HeLa with x from 4 to 8
locus_b: Figure 2: HeLa spans 1.6e6-2.6e8 (log 6.2-8.4) and RAW264.7 spans 5.6e4-1.2e7 (log 4.7-7.1), which on sight matches D=HeLa and E=RAW, i.e. swapped
what_we_emitted: the titles AS PRINTED (D = RAW264.7 -> spleen, E = HeLa -> lungs)
why: RETRACTED SUSPICION, kept with the measurement that retired it. 07_qc.json check X1 correlates all three cell lines against all three organs from our own extraction: RAW->spleen 0.731 beats RAW->lungs 0.493 and RAW->liver -0.139; HeLa->lungs 0.820 beats 0.438/-0.245; HepG2->lungs 0.802 beats 0.228/-0.091. Each labelled pairing is the largest in its row by >= 0.15, so the titles are right and the x ranges were misjudged by eye.

locus_a: Results, 'In Vivo Screening': 'both the behaviors of HeLa and HepG2 hepatocyte cells'
locus_b: Methods: HeLa (ATCC CCL-2) is a cervical adenocarcinoma line; the Results themselves introduce it as 'a more general, fibroblast-like cell line'
what_we_emitted: Model_type recorded as the ATCC line name, not as a tissue
why: Cosmetic, but it would mislead anyone keying a biological system off the prose.
